name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: Where Jev is reached: typesafe (needs the key), openrouter, opencode (OpenCode Console) or zen (OpenCode Zen's free Jev, no key). Default: the provider the keys name, zen when there are none.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY; without either, Jev is reached at OpenCode Zen's free endpoint, which needs no key.

baseUrl.title: System One endpoint
baseUrl.description: Endpoint override. Default: TypeSafe with a key, OpenCode Zen without one.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

requireKeepSignal.title: Require a keep signal
requireKeepSignal.description: Fall back to the built-in summarizer when Jev would drop every tool call it judged, rather than applying the largest reduction with no evidence left behind. Off by default to match the original replacement behavior.

measureNativeSummary.title: Measure the built-in summary
measureNativeSummary.description: On a replaced compaction, also run the built-in summarizer to record its message and token size in the measurement. Costs an extra built-in compaction call, so it is off by default.

metricsPath.title: Metrics file
metricsPath.description: Path of a JSONL file the hook appends one measurement line to per compaction. Left unset, the FAST_JEV_METRICS environment variable is read instead.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request. Left unset, it follows the chosen model's measured ceiling.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request. Left unset, it follows the chosen model's measured ceiling.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Jev model name. Left unset, it follows the resolved provider: jev-1.13-free on OpenCode Zen, jev-1.13 on OpenCode Console, jev-latest otherwise.
